approvers: Just me; site manager and the developer client would want a say
reason: I spend about 342 euro a year on cleaning and replacing damaged frames out of contingency. Paying 19 euro per m2 on a 1,000 m2 year is 19,000, which is far more than the problem costs me. It is not worth my time or margin.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and I would be paying 19,000 to take on a new risk for a problem that costs me 342.
instead: Keep doing nothing special: clean and polish at snagging, pay for the odd damaged item from contingency, and cover frames with cheap tape or film on a few premium units if needed.
would_change_my_mind: Written cover from ACHV or the manufacturer for any damage the coating causes on removal, plus a price under about 5 euro per m2 all-in, or a client who insists on protected handover and pays for it.
